decisions.reason: The organic salami platter fits the firm's announced organic expansion and has stayed on the website for two years, so the commitment and strategic fit favor keeping it despite reduced visibility.
The premium Salamissimo Aperitivo snack was publicly promoted and extended with a poultry variant in 2024, a visible further investment that management will want to justify by persisting.

The organic boiled pork sausage was just launched in 2024 with its own page and a public 'new in the organic team' announcement, so any weak early results can still be attributed to the start-up phase.

The organic thinly sliced chicken breast is a 2024 launch in two flavors with its own page, central to the organic and new-format direction, so dropping it now would contradict a fresh public commitment.
The organic herb-coated salami is a recent launch with dedicated web presence, close to the firm's core salami competence, so management will give it time before judging it.
